contract.packing: Each K row starts a new u32 word; N adjacent unsigned values low bits first; row tail bits zero
contract.zeroPoint: u32 same group-major shape, in unsigned code range
contract.dequant: B16=RN16((q-zp)*decodeHalf(scale)); CPU predecode for A/B/C, packed input retained for future D
contract.multiplyAccumulate: explicit fma(f16,f16,f16)->f16, increasing K; CPU canonical fused RN-even model; WGSL does not guarantee bitwise identity
contract.output: binary16 numerical value widened losslessly to f32 readback/storage carrier
contract.fallback: FP32 arithmetic on SAME decoded activation and B16, distinct nonconforming fallback
contract.shapes: Representative M1/M128,K=N1024; no confirmed logical layer shape
contract.inputAmplitude: exact A=-1,0,1; q-zp=-1,0,1,scale1;fractional A integers[-16,16]/64, scales1/32(Q4) or1/512(Q8), full-range unsigned q,zp near midpoint
contract.scope: Synthetic quantization,NOT Gemma packing reproduction; Q4 or Q8 selectable per independent run

references.high: Sequential binary64 from stored A half and actual q/zp/half scale before dequant rounding
references.semantic: CPU binary16 RN-even fused increasing-K model,not bitwise WGSL guarantee
references.fp32: Explicit FP32 sequential accumulation of same A/B16;also original FP32 numerical reference
